notes: Starting cards as posted under 'Starting (8)': Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost, 'An Entire Legion of My Best Troops (or Biker Scout Gear)', Battle Order, Combat Response, Prepared Defenses, Endor: Bunker, Endor: Landing Platform (Docking Bay) and Endor; these count toward the 60. Three Effects start (the strategy: 'Start out with Entire Legion, Battle Order, and Combat Response') and none is named as the starting Effect, so starting.effect is left empty.

The post gives two versions in one list ('Replace with () stuff for the biker scout version'). Lines that name a card with an alternative are kept as written: 'An Entire Legion of My Best Troops (or Biker Scout Gear)', 'Elite Squadron Stormtrooper x3 (or Unique Speeder Bike Pilots x3)', 'Sergeant Tarl (or Unique Biker Scout)', 'Corporal Drazin (or Unique Biker Scout)', 'Sergeant Wallen (or Unique Biker Scout)', 'Trooper Assault (or Relentless Tracking-effect)', 'Blast Points (or Speeder Bike)' and 'Blaster Rifle x3 (or Speeder Bike x3)'. The main (stormtrooper) version uses the first card of each line: An Entire Legion Of My Best Troops, Elite Squadron Stormtrooper, Sergeant Tarl, Corporal Drazin, Sergeant Wallen, Trooper Assault, Blast Points and Blaster Rifle.
Posted 'Endor System' dested the Dark Endor system; the Endor sites (Bunker, Landing Platform, Dense Forest, Dark Forest, Forest Clearing, Ancient Forest) dested the Dark pages.
The section counts as posted (8+19+4+4+4+10+5+6) total 60.
